source.fit: 26 measured values (26 from the ThermoML Archive), 283.15-413.15 K, max deviation 32 %. No measured critical constants: the record covers the measured temperatures only. All the measured sets fitted together, each article with the same weight (no set preferred for a smaller stated uncertainty), pooled because they agree: each set lies within its mean stated uncertainty of the curve on average, except a narrow miss the maintainer accepted (2026-10-14): Lomba 2014 (mean deviation +2.96 %, mean stated uncertainty 2.59 %); mean deviation of the fit from each set: Lomba 2014 +2.96 %; Sanz 2005 +9.48 %. The largest deviations are at values whose stated uncertainty exceeds 10 % (3 values, 10-24 %); among the values stated within 10 %, the largest deviation is 11 %.
